purpose: Introduce a new topic or a conversational aside.
keywords: By the way, what time are we meeting tomorrow?
By the way, how is your older brother?
By the way, is there a bank nearby?
restrictions: Usually the new topic is only loosely connected to the previous one.
mistake: This connective differs from verb past + ところで meaning even if.

segments.role: Introduce a new topic or a conversational aside. ところで + new topic
